selection_rule: Maximum full-validation pixel-pooled ID5 Dice; exact ties choose lower CE, then earlier epoch
ce_retention_rule: Minimum full-validation valid-pixel CE; exact ties choose earlier epoch
label_mapping_boundary: ID5=prostate remains the user-accepted unverified derivative-ID-preservation assumption.
aggregation: Full-validation valid-pixel pooled confusion counts; not mean batch or case-balanced Dice.
training_wall_clock_note: Training-stage wall time includes input I/O and metric computation. Model-run order and filesystem/cache state were not isolated, so differences in total training time cannot be attributed to architecture-only compute speed. Use the separate warmed-up synthetic forward profile for pure forward comparisons.

training.scope: Maximum absolute PyTorch allocator peak within this phase; includes stated resident objects and cached reserved memory. Not a delta, total GPU VRAM or an isolated optimizer-free model measurement.

interpretation.meaning: ID5 priority selects a higher-overlap validation model while CE and foreground macro Dice remain worse; this is a selection-policy effect on actually reproduced candidates, not evidence of a changed training algorithm or universal quality improvement.
interpretation.wall_clock: Two run totals are 5792.112 seconds. Input I/O, system/cache/load, extra saves and reference probes are included; these times are not isolated architecture compute benchmarks. Profile timings are local snapshots with all raw repetitions retained.
